newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian Stocks to Watch Today - June 2.
newsitem.headline: Australian Stocks to Watch Today - June 2.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:

Coca Cola Amatil Ltd will concede Philippines' San Miguel Corp a fourth board seat, The Australian Financial Review newspaper reported on Monday. The concession should allow the two companies to complete the share and asset swap by the end of next week.

The potential for pay tv advertising in Australia is over-stated and it will be several years before it becomes a meaningful revenue stream, Australis Media chief executive Sean O'Halloran said on Sunday. Australis also announced late on Friday that the Supreme Court of New South Wales on Friday had ruled against the proposed joint infrastructure venture between Australis Media Ltd and Optus Vision, the pay TV arm of Optus Communications Pty Ltd. Australis' 9-month results were also delayed.
Spicers Paper Ltd said on Friday that it now forecast a reduced profit for the year to June 30 due to a continuation of the fall in domestic paper prices.
Lang Corp posted a sharp rise in first half operating profit to A$15.04 million late on Frdiay.
